note: First registration to https://402index.io/ via POST /api/v1/register (open, unauthenticated) on 2026-09-08, at the orphan-patch.561.group custom domain. The POST returned HTTP 201 with status "pending" and health_status "healthy" inline in the registration response; that response's own verification block independently corroborated the real Base-mainnet x402 challenge (httpStatus 402, network eip155:8453, payTo 0x32886F6F361C1d570255c2762967A2e41D0E9B1a, assetKnown true). A GET on the new id minutes later returned HTTP 404 {"error":"Service not found"} -- 402index's id-lookup endpoint does not expose a self-registered listing while it is "pending" review (the same behavior observed re-registering paid-ephemeris-gateway and base-chain-data-gateway tonight). The verbatim status fields below are the ones the 201 response carried, not a later GET.
status: live (Cloudflare Workers custom domain orphan-patch.561.group; Base mainnet settlement via facilitator.payai.network; payout to founder-controlled 0x32886F6F361C1d570255c2762967A2e41D0E9B1a)

domainClaim.outcome: No verify file has ever been served at this domain. A POST /api/v1/claim would return a fresh, unpublished verification hash whose only path to success is placing a new file at that well-known URL -- a Worker/DNS change. Per standing instruction (attempt the claim/verify flow for this domain only if it needs no Worker change), the claim step was not initiated here. Founder-hands item: run POST /api/v1/claim {"domain":"orphan-patch.561.group"}, publish the returned hash at /.well-known/402index-verify.txt (a wrangler deploy or a static route addition), then POST /api/v1/claim/verify with the same domain.
